about: A copy of OpenStreetMap (ODbL 1.0, © OpenStreetMap contributors) for site checks, hosted by the AI Living World Atlas and built weekly from Geofabrik extracts by osm/ in github.com/pushpingeo/ai-living-world-atlas. Files are FlatGeobuf with a spatial index; GeoParquet copies sit beside them where built (files.<group>.parquet).
